title: Quantitative binned heatmap
intent: Reveal the joint distribution of penguin bill length and depth with a fixed two-dimensional bin grid.

ai.create: Create a responsive two-dimensional heatmap from the Palmer Penguins bill measurements using fixed quantitative bins on both axes and cell color for count.
ai.maintain: Change the bin interval while preserving equivalent Plot and granular d3-array boundaries, continuous color semantics, and inferred endpoint types.
